Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

Airbyte is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing sales organization. In this role, you will own a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts and be responsible for generating, progressing, and closing new business across Airbyte’s product offerings.

title: Legal Counsel, Government and Defense

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. - Assist in drafting company policies and prepare employee government contracts and compliance training.

- Proactively manage other duties that may arise as part of a legal team in a high growth start-up.

- Experience with a diverse range of U.S. Government contract types (e.g., FFP, T&M, CPFF) and contract vehicles (e.g., FAR-based contracts, Other Transaction Authority (OTA), subcontracts, software licenses)

Thought Leader Engagement & Strategy

• Partner with marketeers to develop and execute a strategic OL engagement plan aligned to brand and GI franchise objectives.

Compliance & Governance

• Ensure all OL engagements are conducted in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

• Partner with marketing project owner, legal, and compliance teams to ensure consistent and appropriate engagement practices.

title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for tens of thousands of developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year: language tutors that talk back, customer support and sales agents running real call volume, healthcare intake, coaching and training software, in-game characters, and the voice and video layer for robots.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for our first Product Operations Manager. Our product team is small, senior, and growing fast, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations of a new part of the business. As the team grows, the work that connects it (how we plan, set and measure goals, keep the roadmap honest, run our rituals, learn from customers, and bring new people up to speed) needs an owner.

This role is that owner. Your customers are the PMs and the head of product, and your job is to make them faster and better at what they do. You won't be inheriting a process manual or enforcing one. You'll be designing how a product team works at the moment it goes from a handful of people to a real organization, inside an engineering culture that values autonomy and only adopts what makes people's lives easier.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

- see the people you support as customers, and start from their problems rather than from a framework

- like building systems from scratch more than maintaining them

- would rather remove a meeting than add one

- write clearly and enjoy making complicated things legible

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tools and techniques, including AI

The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit's product, understanding how we work, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run the product team's operating cadence. You own the calendar of planning cycles, reviews, and recurring updates: what each one is for, who needs to be there, what goes in, and what comes out. You make sure decisions and follow-ups are captured and visible to everyone who needs them, and you keep retiring or reshaping rituals that stop earning their time.

- Own the roadmap as a system. You own how the roadmap is structured, at the right altitude for each audience, from engineering teams to leadership to sales. You make sure it stays current and becomes the place people go to find out what we're building and where it stands.

- Make goals and progress visible. You run goal-setting for the product team so that every goal is measurable against a clear source of truth, and you track progress against those goals through the quarter. With our data team, you own the reporting the product team and leadership rely on, and you flag drift early.

- Keep the product development playbook. You maintain lightweight shared standards for each step from framing a problem through launch: problem briefs, launch readiness, product stage definitions, release notes. With marketing, you run the internal side of every launch so each one ships with docs, pricing, and GTM ready.

- Run the customer insight engine. You own the systems that keep customers close to the product team: a research repository people use, a continuous pipeline of customer conversations set up with sales and success, and a steady synthesis of what we hear from sales, support, surveys, and deals, delivered to the PMs who need it.

- Grow the craft of the PM team. You own onboarding for new PMs, ongoing training, and the team's community of practice, and you help shape how we hire and level PMs.

- Choose and run the team's tools. You decide how the product team uses its tools, from roadmapping and analytics to AI, and you make sure PMs get real leverage from them.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Board-certified Nurse Practitioner (FNP, AGNP, or other relevant specialties)

•

• A clinical style that will work well with our belief that healthy, long-term, sustainable weight-loss is impossible to achieve without dedicated medical and coaching support

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

About Oper
Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.
The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.
A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium.
Your Mission
We are looking for a Business Analyst (DACH) to join our Customer Success team.
You will start with one of our flagship Austrian customers, owning the delivery work that turns their business needs into a configured, live Oper platform. As we continue to grow in DACH, you will expand into a broader portfolio of German-speaking lenders, becoming the trusted delivery partner who guides them from kickoff to value.
This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys structuring messy problems, sitting in a workshop with bankers and product owners, and translating what they hear into something concrete the engineering team can build and the customer can run. It is also a role for someone who is AI-native , who uses modern AI tooling as a core part of how they think, write, and ship.
Tasks

Capture and structure customer requirements
You will be the bridge between what the customer wants and what Oper delivers.

• Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders at our DACH customers

• Capture functional and business requirements in clear, well-structured documentation

•
Map requirements to Oper's product : identify what works out-of-the-box, what needs configuration, and what genuinely needs engineering

• Translate business needs into user stories and functional specifications the squad can act on

• Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle

Analyze integration points
Our customers run on complex banking stacks. You will figure out how Oper plugs in cleanly.

• Work with Oper engineering to identify and define integration points

• Document data flows, contracts, and edge cases so nothing surprises us at go-live

• Make smart, pragmatic recommendations on what to integrate now vs. later

Configure workflows and deliver value
You will own the hands-on configuration work that makes Oper work for each customer.

• Configure mortgage products, business rules, and customer journeys inside the Oper platform

• Validate that configurations match the agreed scope and pass acceptance testing

• Lead training sessions for end users and customer champions

• Stay close to the customer through go-live and early adoption, then hand over cleanly to the Customer Success team

Work AI-native

• Identify where AI compounds your work and where it does not, and design your workflow accordingly

title: Engineering Manager Runtime - Storage
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Container runtimes were designed for general-purpose software workloads. AI inference is not a general-purpose workload.

Running large models at production scale exposes cracks in every layer of the container stack: runtimes unaware of GPU memory constraints, images that take minutes to pull when a model needs to scale to thousands of replicas, and isolation mechanisms that weren’t designed for the multi-tenant serving environments that production AI requires. The tools the industry has relied on for a decade weren’t built for this, and patching around those limitations at higher layers only goes so far.

Baseten owns the entire pipeline, from the moment a developer pushes a model to the moment a request gets a response. That vertical ownership means we can fix these problems at the root. The Runtime Fabric team is doing exactly that: purpose-building the container runtime and storage layers for AI inference workloads, led by some of the world’s top containerd maintainers.

As Engineering Manager for Storage Products on the Runtime Fabric team, you will lead the engineers who build and run the storage products behind that stack: the Baseten Delivery Network (BDN), which sits in the cold start path of every model on the platform, the snapshotters and filesystems that expose model weights and container images to a running container, and the storage that model deployment and training need next. The team is advancing the next generation of caching for inference workloads, from the origin tier to the GPU host. You will own reliability for the area as a measured outcome, report to the head of Runtime Fabric, and stay close to the code through design and code review. If you’ve managed systems engineers and have hands-on experience with caching, content-addressable storage, or distributed filesystems, we’d love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- How the Baseten Delivery Network (BDN) makes cold starts fast https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-the-baseten-delivery-network-bdn-makes-cold-starts-fast/

- Extending BDN from model weights to container image layers, training checkpoints, and deployment artifacts

- Lazy-loading snapshotters and block-level delivery (EROFS, FUSE, ublk) so a container can start before the full image or model has arrived

RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership and Culture

- Hire and grow a team of 5 to 10 systems engineers with storage, caching, and Linux expertise

- Run the team’s planning and delivery: scope work against the Runtime Fabric roadmap, set priorities, and ship on a predictable cadence

- Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development support to your direct reports

- Own on-call health for the team’s services, including escalation paths and follow-through on incidents

Technical Direction

- Guide the architecture and evolution of the Baseten Delivery Network: the tiered caching and weight delivery product that makes cold starts 2-3x faster and eliminates thundering herd failures during burst scaling events

- Shape storage products tailored to Baseten’s workloads: extend BDN from model weights to container images, training checkpoints, and deployment artifacts, and define the interfaces that model deployment, training, and customers use to reach them

- Oversee the on-host side of delivery: lazy-loading snapshotters, EROFS and overlayfs layouts, and block-level delivery (FUSE, ublk)

•
Advanced Statistical Modeling: Develop mathematical, statistical, and machine learning models to analyze global traffic flows, predict latency anomalies, and optimize routing efficiency.

•

title: Stage Mechatronica: EPLAN Fluid
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in de huidige manier van werken rondom hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s binnen NPD Mechanical Engineering. Op dit moment worden de schema’s opgesteld op een manier die niet-configureerbaar is en beperkte mogelijkheden biedt, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het printen en hergebruiken van coderingen. Je onderzoekt hoe EPLAN Fluid het beste ingezet kan worden om de huidige aanpak eventueel te vervangen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar “hoe het kan”, maar vooral naar “hoe het moet”. Je werkt hierbij samen met engineers en krijgt de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Je sluit af met een proof of concept: een volledig hydraulisch en pneumatisch machineschema dat als referentie kan dienen voor nieuwe machineontwikkeling. Mogelijke onderdelen van je opdracht: In kaart brengen van de huidige werkwijze en knelpunten rond hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s; Opstellen van een gestandaardiseerde werkwijze; Verkennen van configuratie- en documentatiemogelijkheden binnen EPLAN Fluid; Bouwen van een proof of concept als referentie; Opleveren van een korte handleiding en overdracht naar de engineers. Wij vragen Een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

You’ll own our TikTok and Instagram (@getknowt) end to end and make them the account students actually want to follow: funny, relatable, and useful.
This isn’t a brand marketing job. You’re not talking at high schoolers. You’re one of them, or close enough that you still speak the language. You know the 2am cram sessions, the group chat panic before an AP exam, the SAT score reveal, and the Common App essay spiral, and you know how to turn all of it into content that hits.

• Fully remote

• Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to account growth

What you’ll do
Create

• Take each video from idea to posted: hook, script, filming, editing, caption.

• Make content about what high schoolers are actually dealing with (AP exams, the SAT and ACT, finals, college apps, test stress) and make it feel like it came from a friend, not a company.

• Work Knowt into content naturally, so students want to watch it and then use the app.

• Keep every post native to the platform and to high school culture: current sounds, formats, humor, and slang that’s actually in use, not cringe.

Grow

• Plan content around the school calendar so you reach students exactly when they need Knowt: AP season, SAT and ACT test dates, finals, application deadlines.

• Turn trends, comment sections, and performance data into new content ideas.

• Ensure L10 test coverage validates system-level integration, board functionality, firmware readiness, thermal behavior, power behavior, I/O functionality, and platform health.

• Work with ODM and internal engineering teams to ensure test execution is scalable, repeatable, and suitable for high-volume server production.

• Specify manufacturing line requirements for test station configuration, test sequencing, data capture, networking, tooling, and operator workflow.

Helmsley Charitable Trust makes it possible to provide our 6-month virtual care, education, and support program to adults with T1D for free. Designed based on need rather than traditional reimbursement rules, our whole-person model is individualized and can include endocrinology care, diabetes education, insurance navigation, peer support, diabetes supportive counseling, help paying for T1D medications and supplies, and connections to community resources. We work alongside existing healthcare providers to fill gaps in care and empower people to manage this 24/7 condition.

We’re building a high-quality, scalable model for better T1D care-and we’re looking for mission-driven professionals who want to help create the healthcare system people with T1D deserve. Our ambition is to reach and support as many people living with T1D across the country as possible, and that urgency shapes how we work: we move quickly, set a high bar, and work hard to turn our mission into meaningful impact at scale.

Blue Circle Health is searching for an experienced MD or DO who will provide virtual patient care, specific to people with type 1 diabetes. Blue Circle Health has a team based, whole person approach to care where we bring together multiple specialties to create a personalized care plan for our patients. The Endocrinologist will conduct telehealth visits and will work with the clinical care team to provide the best care possible to the people we serve. The Endocrinologist will partner closely with the care team - including educators, diabetes supportive counselors, case managers, T1D support guides, and insurance navigators - to guide, educate and empower people living with type 1 diabetes to achieve better health outcomes. Currently we offer 30 minute (follow-up) and 60 minute (new patient) appointments , as we believe spending time with each of our patients is critical. This team includes support from medical assistants and from our technology team.

This role is primarily remote, with potential to attend in-person meetings. All team members also attend our annual in person company retreat. Our patients are currently located in 21 states + Washington D.C., with the intention to expand to additional states throughout the country. We will support the Endocrinologist in obtaining and maintaining licensure upon hire. This role is full-time and requires consistent availability Monday-Friday, with scheduled hours of 11:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. ET on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday. Thursdays are scheduled either 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. ET (preferred) or 11:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. ET . Blue Circle has a call schedule during the work-day but does not currently have off-hours call, however as we expand, this may be a future need. Candidates can live anywhere in the U.S.

Core Responsibilities

• Evaluate and treat our patients with T1D. Conduct medical evaluations, consultations, and provide diabetes-related care using telehealth platforms.

• Provide guidance and care to our patients living with T1D, using evidence-based therapies and following ADA Standards of Care, with a focus on achieving individual goals and optimizing health outcomes.

• In partnership with the Care Team, design individualized treatment plans for each patient, monitor their progress and adjust their therapies as needed.

• Analyze data from all existing diabetes devices and stay up to date on future tech advances in the field

• Teach patients, and new support staff, how to interpret device downloads and adjust insulin dosing and provide additional patient education to support this.

• Address urgent patient inquiries, critical updates, and emergency interventions from patients and team members during work hours on a defined call schedule.

title: Data Architecture & Data Engineering Leader
description:
Data Architecture & Data Engineering Leader
Location : Remote, MUST be located in the United States.
Prefer candidates who reside in the EST time zone or are willing to work EST hours.
Position summary
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader to design, build and run the data platform that powers our media, analytics, client reporting and new data products. This role owns the enterprise data architecture and data roadmap, leads data engineering, and builds the data foundation the business needs to launch scalable, marketable products, while making sure our data is secure, compliant, reliable and ready to scale.
You will partner with business leaders across Media, Strategy, Client Services and Product to turn business needs into trusted, well-governed data solutions. You will also build and mentor a growing data team, including team members in Kraków, Poland.
What you will do
Data architecture and roadmap

• Define and own the roadmap for the enterprise data architecture, in line with company priorities and governance.

• Design the target data architecture, including ingestion, storage, data layers, data models, integrations and the serving layer for reporting and products.

• Document the architecture, data flows and source mappings so knowledge is shared and doesn't sit with one person.

• Set standards for data modeling, pipeline design, naming conventions, code quality, testing and deployment.

• Evaluate data technologies and vendors, make build-vs-buy recommendations, and manage platform cost and performance.
Data engineering and platform

• Own the data platform on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, snowflake, redshift etc, data layers, data models and system integrations.

• Lead the consolidation of multiple reporting and analytics platforms into a single source of truth.

• Design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines from client, vendor, media and first-party sources, using APIs, SFTP and ETL and integration tools.

• Lead platform migrations, including moving legacy data sources to BigQuery, snowflake, redshift etc

• Standardize and template recurring data preparation and client data delivery to reduce custom, manual work.

• Build a well-modeled, well-documented data foundation that supports reporting today and advanced analytics in the future.
Data foundation for new products

• Design and build a reusable, product-ready data foundation (curated datasets, shared data models and governed views) that new products can be built on without starting from scratch.

• Partner with Product Owners and business leaders to turn new product concepts, such as healthcare, audience and market intelligence offerings, into clear data requirements, data models and delivery plans.

• Evaluate the data feasibility of new product ideas, including source availability, quality, licensing, compliance and cost to build and maintain.

title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)
description:
Role Title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging expert Vloggers to contribute to a cutting-edge customer project focused on capturing high-quality, naturalistic video data using 360° and action cameras. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will record themselves performing everyday activities across indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments using compatible equipment, providing crucial video resources for advanced AI research.
Scope of Work

• Capture a diverse set of continuous video clips (minimum 60 seconds each) of everyday activities in a range of environments, including indoor, outdoor, and in-vehicle settings.

• Consistently utilize compatible 360° or wide-angle cameras (e.g., Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX series) with at least 170° FOV and 720p resolution, ensuring stable, third-person perspective according to project standards.

• Implement appropriate mounting solutions, such as backpack or vehicle mounts, to maintain a clear third-person view where your entire body and surroundings are visible throughout each activity.

• Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.

• Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.

• Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.

• Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.

Compatible camera examples include:

• Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6

• DJI Osmo 360

• GoPro MAX, MAX2

• Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

• Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.

• Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

Third-Person Camera Setup

• Mounted above and behind you

• Angled slightly downward

• Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible

• Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.
Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.
Expected Recording Tasks may include:

• Natural everyday activities

• Indoor and outdoor activities

• Walking and moving through different environments

• Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings

• Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.
Recording Requirements

• Capture a variety of activities and environments

• Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long

• Record at a minimum resolution of 720p

• Follow the required camera position for each assigned task

• Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible

• Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. title: Scientific Software Engineer (Lab Integration)
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.

This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.

You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own.

YOUR IMPACT

You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Help shape how we connect to partner labs around the world, accounting for different levels of automation and AI-readiness, then design, build and operate the services that send experiment requests from our AI agents and reliably bring results back.

- Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange.

- Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

- Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

- Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly.

- Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design.

- Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines.

- Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services.

- Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design.

- Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts.

- Solid understanding of security practices

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Over WPP Media

Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

• Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.

• Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.

• Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.

• Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.

• Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.

• Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.

• Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.

• Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

Small drones are hard to hit. Hitting them from a moving aircraft is harder. We need a Staff Software Engineer to own software integration of Omen’s airborne counter-UAS effector payload end to end, and to build the team around it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own and lead the autonomy architecture for Omen’s cUAS dogfighting mission end to end, from first prototype to fielded software. Find the target, fly the fight, take the shot.

• Collaborate with the Omen Perception team to develop target tracking and perception. Architect the optimal approach to combine data from multiple sensor sources to meet demanding mission objectives.

• Design the intercept guidance and pursuit planning that puts the aircraft in a firing position against a maneuvering target, within the vehicle’s operational limits.

• Work alongside the Omen Autonomy team which owns core autonomy systems and will embed autonomy engineers on your team for specific tactics development.

• Own fire control software. Lead and ballistic solutions, targeting commands, and the logic that decides when to shoot.

• Hold the sensor-to-shot latency budget and know where every millisecond goes.

• Own software interfaces with the payload, vehicle, and mission compute. Message definitions, timing, time sync, and command authority.

• Build the simulation that proves the engagement works before flight. Then plan and run flight test campaigns, including live range events, and lead the root-cause work when results don’t match prediction.

• Take it to the field. Verification and validation, release and configuration control, and the sustainment path for fielded software. Write requirements for SEIT and V&V engineers to test and validate your system.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 6+ years building software for robotic or autonomous systems, including at least one system you carried from concept to field deployment

• Strong engineering background, ideally in Robotics, Computer Science, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering

• Experience leading multidisciplinary software teams, including hiring

• Strong Rust or C++ for real-time and embedded systems, plus Python for tools and analysis

• Deep experience in target tracking and sensor fusion: state estimation, filtering, data association, and track quality on small, maneuvering targets

• Experience with guidance, motion planning, or control for fast-moving vehicles, and a working grasp of the latency and bandwidth tradeoffs that come with it

• Experience integrating and characterizing perception sensors in software.

• Experience building

title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - US (Remote)
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.
Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.
What You'll Do
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them
Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call
Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built
Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools
